race.comment: ANDERSHINE (4) is the most interesting runner as an unraced gelding who has been given two 1000m Belmont Park trials, the latest a second beaten 2.8 lengths. He had the blinkers on there and that was the best trial of his career thus far. The 3kg claim comes in handy and he can score a debut victory. DIAMAS (7) has the clearest local race form, having been beaten a nose at this track before going for a break. Resumes over the sprint trip, but she was sound when first-up last campaign. Can feature. ALDEZOR (2) brings different form, dropping out of a Wyong 3yo+ Class 1 and now with Ron Cowl. Right back in trip, but he had sprinted well earlier in his career. Finds the right race. IL BELLO BEALS (1) is hard to dismiss for the multiples after placing 11 times from 24 starts and finishing third to Encosta De Money here, but he has had plenty of chances and must turn consistency into a win. SUMMER MOOD (6) can resume on a positive note if she runs up to the form she showed last campaign.
